Class AllSetFoodStrategy

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.strategy.CardStrategy
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.strategy.AllSetFoodStrategy
public class AllSetFoodStrategy extends CardStrategy
Building effect that rewards the player with food whenever a new complete character set is formed.

A "set" is one character of every type; the number of complete sets equals the size of the smallest per-type list in the tribe (minListSize). This effect is registered on the pick channel: at each pick it checks whether the set count grew and, if so, grants 5 food per newly completed set. The internal counter is seeded at registration time with the sets already owned, so only sets formed afterwards are rewarded.
